question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date))
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-25') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) = 25;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.customer_id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customers
    WHERE (
        -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-24
        -- Check that the 25th anniversary of birth_date is on or before 2026-09-24
        -- and the 26th anniversary is after 2026-09-24
        -- Using text comparison for dates in format 'YYYY-MM-DD'
        substr(birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(birth_date, 9, 2) <= '09-24'
        AND substr(birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(birth_date, 9, 2) > '09-24'
        OR (
            substr(birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(birth_date, 9, 2) = '09-24'
            AND birth_date IS NOT NULL
        )
    )
    AND (
        -- For same month/day, check if the year allows exactly 25 years
        CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 2026 - 25
    )
    AND (
        -- For different month/day, check if birthday has passed in 2026
        substr(birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(birth_date, 9, 2) < '09-24'
        AND CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 2026 - 25 - 1
        OR substr(birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(birth_date, 9, 2) > '09-24'
        AND CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 2026 - 25
    )
);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    (
        -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-26
        -- Born on 2001-09-26 would make them exactly 25 on 2026-09-26
        c.birth_date = '2001-09-26'
        OR
        -- Handle leap years: born on 2001-02-29 (doesn't exist, so this case won't occur)
        -- For someone born on Feb 29 in a leap year, they turn 25 on Feb 28 in non-leap years
        -- But 2001 is not a leap year, so Feb 29 2001 doesn't exist
        -- So we only need to check for the exact date match
        (c.birth_date = '2001-02-29' AND '2026-09-26' >= '2026-02-28')
    )
    AND o.date >= '2026-09-26' AND o.date < '2026-09-27';
